crossRefs.note: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk…
“Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my…
Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and…
for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
We love him, because he first loved us.
Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will…
I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in…
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t…
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…
